headings.usage: Use for all page titles, section headers, and widget titles. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, and data points. Normal tracking.

mono.usage: Use for API keys, device IDs, and raw data logs.

containers.glass_panel: bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 shadow-lg rounded-3xl

hero_solar_home.usage: Landing page hero section background or side image

icon_libraries.special: Use distinct icons for devices: Sun (Solar), Shield (Security), Thermometer (Geyser), Key (Door)

chart_libraries.usage: Use AreaChart for solar generation, BarChart for energy consumption. Style with gradient fills.

universal_guidelines: Always use 'Outfit' font for headings and 'DM Sans' for body text.
Do not use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-900 (#0F172A) instead.
Use 2x-3x more padding than standard. Minimum p-6 for cards.
Buttons must have a 'pill' shape (rounded-full) for a modern consumer app feel.
Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur) is key for the 'Futuristic' feel. Use it on sticky headers and floating widgets.
Every interactive element must have a hover state.
Use skeleton loaders for data fetching states.
Ensure high contrast for text (Slate-600 minimum for body text).
Solar graphs should use Amber/Orange gradients. Climate graphs use Blue/Cyan gradients.
Security alerts must be Red/Rose but not alarming - use soft backgrounds with bold text.
For the 'Pakistani context', ensure the 'Family' and 'Multi-home' features are prominent.
Data-testid attributes are MANDATORY for all interactive elements.
